name: cascade_delete
description: In the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler, the explicit application-level child delete `Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey: c_custkey } })` removes all orders before deleting the customer. This matches the unsafe delete cascade signal because `/api/orders/summary` is documented to report historical orders, so deleting customer rows also causes observable loss of child order data needed by another endpoint.
